mapper.select: select r.roleId ,r.role from EmployeeRole er inner join RolesInfo r on er.roleId=r.roleId where er.empId=#{empId};
mapper.update: update EmployeeInfo set password=#{newPassword}, firstLoginStatus=1 where email=#{email};
update EmployeeInfo set password=#{newPassword} where email=#{email};
mapper.insert: insert into ConfirmationToken(token,tokenCreationDate,tokenExpiryDate,empId) values(#{token},#{tokenCreationDate},#{tokenExpiryDate},(select empId from EmployeeInfo where email=#{user.email}))
mapper.update: update ConfirmationToken t inner join EmployeeInfo e on t.empId=e.empId set t.token=#{token},t.tokenCreationDate=#{tokenCreationDate},t.tokenExpiryDate=#{tokenExpiryDate} where e.email=#{user.email}
mapper.select: select t.empId ,t.token,e.email,t.tokenExpiryDate from ConfirmationToken t inner join EmployeeInfo e on e.empId=t.empId where e.email=#{user.email}
select t.tokenExpiryDate,t.token,t.empId from ConfirmationToken t inner join EmployeeInfo e on e.empId=t.empId where t.token=#{token}
mapper.delete: delete t from ConfirmationToken t inner join EmployeeInfo e on e.empId=t.empId where e.email=#{email}
mapper.select: select * from LoginTransaction lt inner join EmployeeInfo e on e.empId=lt.empId where lt.passwordExpiryDate <> '' and e.email=#{user.email} and lt.loginTimestamp=(select MAX(loginTimestamp) from LoginTransaction) LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: insert into LoginTransaction(empId,loginTimestamp,lastPasswordChange,passwordExpiryDate,activityStatus,statusReason) values((select empId from EmployeeInfo where email=#{user.email}),#{loginTimestamp},#{lastPasswordChange},#{passwordExpiryDate},#{activityStatus},#{statusReason})
mapper.select: select e.email,e.mailFlag,e.empId,e.password from EmployeeInfo e where e.mailFlag='NO';
